description: PTS1 dodecamer context hydrophobicity: AMD2 versus all bona fide yeast PTS1 peroxisomal proteins
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests, re
from scipy import stats

P = pd.read_csv("yeast_proteome_cterm_pts1.csv")   # 6067 reviewed yeast proteins, from iteration 1
# re-fetch sequences to get dodecamers
def fasta_parse(txt):
    out={}; k=None; b=[]
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith(">"):
            if k: out[k]="".join(b)
            k=ln[1:]; b=[]
        else: b.append(ln.strip())
    if k: out[k]="".join(b)
    return out
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
  params={"query":"proteome:UP000002311 AND reviewed:true","format":"fasta"},timeout=300)
fa=fasta_parse(r.text)
seqs={h.split("|")[1]:s for h,s in fa.items()}
kd = dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
          K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def upg(s):
    u=s[-12:-3]
    return np.mean([kd[x] for x in u if x in kd]) if len(u)>=5 else np.nan
P["up_gravy"]=P.acc.map(lambda a: upg(seqs[a]) if a in seqs and len(seqs[a])>=15 else np.nan)
P["up_arom"]=P.acc.map(lambda a: sum(x in "FWY" for x in seqs[a][-12:-3]) if a in seqs and len(seqs[a])>=15 else np.nan)

amd=P[P.acc=="P22580"].iloc[0]
pts1_perox = P[(P.strict) & (P.perox)]          # bona fide yeast PTS1 peroxisomal proteins
allp = P.dropna(subset=["up_gravy"])
print(f"n bona fide strict-PTS1 peroxisomal yeast proteins: {len(pts1_perox)}")
print("their up_gravy: mean %.2f, sd %.2f, max %.2f" % (pts1_perox.up_gravy.mean(), pts1_perox.up_gravy.std(), pts1_perox.up_gravy.max()))
print("their aromatic count in -12..-4: mean %.2f, max %d" % (pts1_perox.up_arom.mean(), pts1_perox.up_arom.max()))
print(f"\nAMD2 up_gravy = {amd.up_gravy:.2f}, aromatics = {int(amd.up_arom)}")
z=(amd.up_gravy-pts1_perox.up_gravy.mean())/pts1_perox.up_gravy.std()
print(f"AMD2 z-score vs the PTS1-peroxisomal distribution: {z:.2f}")
print(f"AMD2 percentile among ALL yeast proteins for C-terminal dodecamer hydrophobicity: "
      f"{stats.percentileofscore(allp.up_gravy, amd.up_gravy):.1f}")
print(f"fraction of strict-PTS1 peroxisomal proteins with up_gravy >= AMD2: "
      f"{(pts1_perox.up_gravy>=amd.up_gravy).mean():.3f} ({(pts1_perox.up_gravy>=amd.up_gravy).sum()}/{len(pts1_perox)})")
# also among the 465 permissive-PTS1 proteins, do the peroxisomal ones differ?
perm=P[P.perm].dropna(subset=["up_gravy"])
a=perm[perm.perox].up_gravy; b=perm[~perm.perox].up_gravy
print(f"\nwithin permissive-PTS1 proteins: peroxisomal up_gravy mean {a.mean():.2f} (n={len(a)}), "
      f"non-peroxisomal {b.mean():.2f} (n={len(b)}), MWU p={stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b).pvalue:.3f}")

P.to_csv("yeast_cterm_dodecamer_context.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.8))
ax.hist(pts1_perox.up_gravy, bins=np.arange(-3,2.6,0.35), color="#2a7fbf", alpha=.85,
        label=f"bona fide yeast PTS1 peroxisomal proteins (n={len(pts1_perox)})")
ax.axvline(amd.up_gravy, color="#d1495b", lw=2.6)
ax.text(amd.up_gravy-0.06, ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.88, "AMD2\n(VCKFASWLF)", color="#d1495b",
        ha="right", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlabel("GRAVY of PTS1 dodecamer context (residues -12 to -4)")
ax.set_ylabel("number of proteins")
ax.set_title("AMD2's C-terminal context is hydrophobic and aromatic, unlike every yeast PTS1 protein\n"
             "(the PTS1 is a dodecamer that must stay solvent-exposed for Pex5 capture)", fontsize=10.5)
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
[ax.spines[s].set_visible(False) for s in ("top","right")]
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
